TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_course
TABLE.COMMENT: Tracks whether each course is currently represented in the RAG index, so that toggling a course's ingestion marking can trigger a one-time re-index (on enable) or purge (on disable) instead of acting on every course edit.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course.

FIELD.NAME: ingested
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when at least one of the course's documents is in the index. This is what consumers such as the tutor ask before grounding answers in course sources.

FIELD.NAME: pending
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when documents are still outstanding. Independent of ingested: a partly ingested course has both set, so the tutor can already use the sources while the reconcile keeps working.

FIELD.NAME: sink
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the destination the course was last ingested into. Empty when not ingested.

FIELD.NAME: embeddingmodel
FIELD.COMMENT: Embedding model reported by that destination at the time. Empty when the destination reports none.

FIELD.NAME: tenant
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant id derived from wwwroot at the time. Empty when not ingested.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last state change.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_cm
TABLE.COMMENT: Explicit per-activity ingestion decisions. No row means untouched: the site-wide activitydefault mode decides. Deletions from the index are only ever driven by an explicit exclusion, so switching the mode never touches existing content.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, for bulk reads and course-level cleanup.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module the decision is about.

FIELD.NAME: included
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = explicitly included, 0 = explicitly excluded.

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who made the decision.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the decision was last changed.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_cmstate
TABLE.COMMENT: Site-local index truth per course module: what was last sent where, under which source id and with which content hash. Absence of a row means: not in the index. Deliberately separate from the decisions table, whose rows mean 'a teacher decided'.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, for bulk reads and course-level cleanup.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module.

FIELD.NAME: sink
FIELD.COMMENT: Destination id the content was sent to.

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Module-level source id at ingest time; freezes the tenant so later deletes stay exact.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 over the final document tuples of the set last accepted by the destination; empty until an upsert was accepted. For a destination that confirms asynchronously the hash is written on acceptance, not on confirmation.

FIELD.NAME: laststatus
FIELD.COMMENT: success (confirmed in the index), queued (accepted, confirmation pending), error, or empty (worked through, nothing to send).

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Consecutive failed attempts. Reset by a success. Once it reaches the retry limit the module is skipped until a forced reindex, so one broken document cannot stall the course every reconcile run.

FIELD.NAME: lasterror
FIELD.COMMENT: Last error message when laststatus is error; why there was nothing to send when it is empty.

FIELD.NAME: timeingested
FIELD.COMMENT: When content last reached the index, as confirmed by the destination.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last row change.

KEY.NAME: cmid
KEY.COMMENT: One state row per course module.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_docstate
TABLE.COMMENT: Per sent document of a module, as reported by a destination that confirms asynchronously: job id, pipeline status and the bookkeeping of the status check. One row per (sub-)document of the set last accepted; replaced on every accepted send and removed with the module state row.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, for status checks per course and course-level cleanup.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module whose state row this document belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The source id the document was sent under (module or sub-document).

FIELD.NAME: ordinal
FIELD.COMMENT: Send order within the module, so the first failure can be named.

FIELD.NAME: jobid
FIELD.COMMENT: Job id from the upsert answer or last_job_id from the status.

FIELD.NAME: remotestatus
FIELD.COMMENT: Pipeline status: queued, running, succeeded, failed, deleted or unknown.

FIELD.NAME: errortype
FIELD.COMMENT: error_type reported by the pipeline.

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: error_message reported by the pipeline.

FIELD.NAME: attemptcount
FIELD.COMMENT: Processing attempts the pipeline reports.

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Processing attempts the pipeline allows; 0 when not reported.

FIELD.NAME: nextretryat
FIELD.COMMENT: When the pipeline retries next; 0 when no retry is scheduled.

FIELD.NAME: statuscheckedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Last successful status check.

FIELD.NAME: timelastcheck
FIELD.COMMENT: Last status check attempt, successful or not; throttles checks from the course page.

FIELD.NAME: nextcheck
FIELD.COMMENT: Earliest next status check (backoff).

FIELD.NAME: checkfailures
FIELD.COMMENT: Consecutive failed status checks.

FIELD.NAME: checkerror
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the last status check failed; null after a successful one.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the destination accepted the document; the confirmation timeout counts from here.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last row change.

INDEX.NAME: sourceid
INDEX.COMMENT: One row per sent source id.

TABLE.NAME: local_elediaai_sources_delq
TABLE.COMMENT: Deletes the destination has not carried out yet (ai_suite#242, #243). One row per source id and scope; a pending row is retried with backoff, a failed row was given up and stays for the report. Holds identifiers and transport errors only, no content and no user data.

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The source id to delete, as sent: a module id for a prefix delete, a (sub-)document id for an exact one.

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: exact (one document) or prefix (the module and all its sub-documents).

FIELD.NAME: sink
FIELD.COMMENT: Destination id the delete is meant for. Rows for another destination than the active one are dropped.

FIELD.NAME: tenant
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant id derived from wwwroot when the row was written. A row whose tenant no longer matches is given up instead of being sent.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the documents belonged to, for the report. Not a foreign key: the course is usually gone.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module the documents belonged to. Not a foreign key: the module is usually gone.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending (waiting for the next attempt) or failed (given up).

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Failed attempts so far.

FIELD.NAME: nextattempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Earliest next attempt; 0 once given up.

FIELD.NAME: lasthttpcode
FIELD.COMMENT: HTTP status of the last failed attempt; 0 for a network error or before the first attempt.

FIELD.NAME: lasterror
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the last attempt failed.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the delete was first queued.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Last row change.
